## Connecting to FISHub

MFA uses Windows integrated authentication to connect to the FISHub database. Load MFA and establish a connection before running database queries:

```{r eval=FALSE}
library(MFA)
con <- FISHub_connect()
```

## Querying FISHub

`FISH_query()` retrieves survey, effort, or catch data. For example, retrieve Status & Trends surveys from 2025:

```{r eval=FALSE}
surveys <- FISH_query(
  con,
  QueryType = "Survey",
  SurveyCategory = "Status & Trends",
  Year = 2025
)
```

Retrieve effort data for a specific survey:

```{r eval=FALSE}
efforts <- FISH_query(
  con,
  QueryType = "Efforts",
  SurveyId = 805
)
```

Retrieve catch data filtered by survey and gear:

```{r eval=FALSE}
catch <- FISH_query(
  con,
  QueryType = "Catch",
  SurveyId = 805,
  GearType = "SMFYKE"
)
```

Catch data include the number and percentage of fish meeting the applicable minimum length. MFA uses default statewide minimum size limits where available; specify an alternative using `Special_Legal_Sizes`:

```{r eval=FALSE}
catch <- FISH_query(
  con,
  QueryType = "Catch",
  SurveyId = 805,
  Special_Legal_Sizes = c("Largemouth Bass" = 10)
)
```

## Fisheries summaries

### Catch summary

`catchSummary()` returns one row per survey and species, including total catch, weighted mean length, minimum and maximum length, and the number and percentage meeting the applicable minimum size limit.

```{r eval=FALSE}
catch_summary <- catchSummary(catch)
```

### Catch per unit effort (CPUE)

`CPUE_byGear()` summarizes catch per unit effort by sampling gear and can return a table or figure:

```{r eval=FALSE}
cpue <- CPUE_byGear(catchData = catch, OutputType = "Table")
CPUE_byGear(catchData = catch, OutputType = "Figure")
```

### Age-length summaries

`ageLengthSummary()` provides raw age-length data, summary statistics, or a length-at-age figure:

```{r eval=FALSE}
age_length_raw <- ageLengthSummary(
  con = con,
  effortData = efforts,
  OutputType = "RawData"
)

age_length_table <- ageLengthSummary(
  con = con,
  effortData = efforts,
  OutputType = "Table"
)

ageLengthSummary(
  con = con,
  effortData = efforts,
  OutputType = "Figure"
)
```

### Detection by year

`detectionByYear()` identifies the years in which each species was detected in the queried catch data:

```{r eval=FALSE}
catchData <- FISH_query(
  con,
  QueryType = "Catch",
  WaterBodyName = "Lake Orion"
)

detection_summary <- detectionByYear(catchData)
```

### Length frequency

`lengthFreqByEffort()` summarizes length frequencies by survey, sampling module, species, and inch group. It can return a table or figure:

```{r eval=FALSE}
length_frequency <- lengthFreqByEffort(
  con = con,
  effortData = efforts,
  OutputType = "Table"
)

lengthFreqByEffort(
  con = con,
  effortData = efforts,
  OutputType = "Figure"
)
```

### Relative stock density

`RSD()` calculates relative stock density using Gabelhouse length categories. For example, RSD-Trophy is calculated as:

$$
RSD\text{-}T =
\frac{N_{Trophy}}
{N_{Stock} + N_{Quality} + N_{Preferred} + N_{Memorable} + N_{Trophy}}
\times 100
$$

Here, each $N$ is the number of fish within the indicated, mutually exclusive length category (Stock, Quality, Preferred, Memorable, or Trophy).

```{r eval=FALSE}
rsd <- RSD(length_frequency)
```

## Function reference

| Function | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `FISHub_connect()` | Connect to the FISHub database |
| `FISH_query()` | Query survey, effort, and catch data |
| `catchSummary()` | Summarize catch |
| `CPUE_byGear()` | Calculate catch per unit effort by gear |
| `ageLengthSummary()` | Summarize age and length data |
| `detectionByYear()` | Summarize species detection by year |
| `lengthFreqByEffort()` | Summarize length-frequency data by effort |
| `RSD()` | Calculate relative stock density |

For detailed arguments and return values, use the function help pages, such as `?FISH_query` or `?RSD`, after loading MFA.

## Closing the database connection

Disconnect when you have finished querying FISHub:

```{r eval=FALSE}
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
```
